definitions.explanation: A chemical substance with a pH below 7, the opposite of an alkali (base). Used as a general noun and as a suffix in names of specific acids ({硫酸|りゅうさん} sulfuric acid, {塩酸|えんさん} hydrochloric acid).

examples.japanese: ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酸|さん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
{酸|さん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦アルカリ→アルカリ：28621_arukari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{中和|ちゅうわ}⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧。
examples.english: When acid and alkali are mixed, a neutralization reaction occurs.

examples.japanese: {胃液|いえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{酸|さん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分解|ぶんかい}する→分解する：21320_bunkaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The strong acid contained in gastric juice breaks down food.

notes:
Used both as a standalone noun in chemistry and food contexts, and as a suffix in the names of specific acids.

COMPOUNDS:
- {硫酸|りゅうさん}: sulfuric acid
- {塩酸|えんさん}: hydrochloric acid
- ⟦{酢酸|さくさん}→酢酸：26325_sakusan⟧: acetic acid
- ⟦{酸性|さんせい}→酸性：00454_sansei⟧: acidic; acidity
- ⟦{酸味|さんみ}→酸味：07016_sanmi⟧: sour taste

SIMILAR / RELATED:
- ⟦アルカリ→アルカリ：28621_arukari⟧: alkali; base — direct chemical opposite
- {酸|す}っぱい: sour (everyday adjective for taste)
- ⟦{酸素|さんそ}→酸素：02830_sanso⟧: oxygen — different word with the same kanji used for its chemistry meaning
